title: Part Ten: The Plans for Gaza

sections.brief: What American and Israeli leaders said they want for Gaza, 2024–2025: Kushner's waterfront, Trump's 'Riviera' and no return, the AI video, the Arab alternative, the 'humanitarian city', Netanyahu's perimeter, the GREAT Trust, Smotrich's 'bonanza'. Figure: timeline; who said what.

From vision to structure: the Board of Peace and its members, Project Sunrise, the New Gaza master plan; what the plans leave out; the people inside the plans; status as of October 2026. Figures: network; money compared with lives.
